body:
When a work run proposes a decision (`task decision`, or `write DECISIONS.md`), the board can't read the task any more: its card is hidden with the notice "Can't read task …". This happened on task:76554b1e77976ad7.

Cause: the question it adds carries `settings: {decision: {title, body}}`, but the task question decoder (`solace_task.question_decoder` in solace-cli/components) accepts only `settings: {base, proposed}`, so the whole task fails to decode.

Fix: a task with a decision proposal reads and shows its card again. The proposal shows as a question with its text and its Approve and Reject options, and answering it records or drops the entry as the server already does (`board::settings.apply_settings`).

Acceptance:
- A task holding a decision proposal question shows on the board and in its details, with no "Can't read task" notice.
- Approving it from the board adds the entry to `DECISIONS.md`; rejecting it adds nothing.
- A test decodes a task with such a question.
- Rebuild the bundled pages that use the shared task component.
title: board: show decision proposals on tasks
